cards.title: Report a reproducible bug
cards.text: Include a minimal reproduction; otherwise: needs-repro.

cards.title: Wait for accepted
cards.text: A maintainer opens discussion. Check timeline (weeks/months/unscheduled) and commitment (committed/open/undecided).

cards.title: Try the proof of concept
cards.text: Check out and run the maintainer's linked draft PR: poc: #123 for issue 123.

cards.title: Open one focused PR per accepted issue
cards.text: A person merges. Agents never approve or merge.

blocks.title: VibeLang
blocks.tagline: Write Effect programs in TypeScript syntax, with typed errors and services the compiler checks.
blocks.text: A simple, readable syntax for Effect that compiles to JavaScript with TypeScript declarations, with first-class access to the TypeScript ecosystem.

blocks.title: Bun alternative
blocks.code:
bun create vibelang@latest my-app
cd my-app
bun run start

cards.title: Every function is an Effect
cards.text: A call runs where it stands: no generators, no yield*.

cards.title: Typed errors
cards.text: error NotFound { id } and User!NotFound in the signature.

cards.title: Services and layers
cards.text: service, provide and Layer as language.

cards.title: Your editor knows it
cards.text: Diagnostics, hovers and completions from the compiler.

cards.title: TypeScript interop
cards.text: Checks .vibe and .ts together; emits JavaScript and types.

blocks.title: Run benchmarks
blocks.code:
# From the repository root:
sh scripts/setup.sh
(cd experiments && bun install --frozen-lockfile)
(cd docs/tools && bun install --frozen-lockfile)
VIBELANG="$PWD/packages/compiler/native/vibelang" sh scripts/bench/compiler.sh --runs 5 --out .cache/bench
node scripts/bench/lsp.mjs packages/compiler/native/vibelang .cache/bench/synth/vibelang
